writing.overall_comment: A competent reference overview that accurately scopes the skill but reads as a glossary of frameworks rather than an actionable guide with concrete examples.

dimensions.name: Semantic accuracy
dimensions.comment: The name and description accurately reflect the skill's coverage of requirements, prioritization, user stories, and strategy, though the description is duplicated verbatim in the Description section and omits roadmap/strategy that the body covers.

dimensions.name: Examples & edge cases
dimensions.comment: Only a placeholder skeleton for a user story and a PRD outline are given—no concrete filled-in examples and no failure paths or edge cases such as conflicting priorities or vague acceptance criteria.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.comment: Frameworks and templates are listed, but there are no explicit step-by-step procedures for how to gather requirements, run prioritization, or resolve trade-offs, leaving execution ambiguous.

suggestions: In the user story and PRD outline sections, replace the placeholder skeletons with fully filled-in examples that demonstrate concrete acceptance criteria, at least one failure path, and edge cases such as conflicting priorities or vague acceptance criteria.

In the frameworks and templates sections, add explicit step-by-step procedures for gathering requirements, running prioritization, and resolving trade-offs so readers can execute each without guessing.

Add a short worked example that applies those step-by-step procedures to the filled-in user story/PRD, showing how to resolve a conflicting-priority trade-off and tighten a vague acceptance criterion.
